notes.title: Patch 2.034 Notes
notes.content:
Kando Realm Patch 2.034 Patch Notes: Releasing today!


😍 NEW CONTENT ALERT! 😍 
New Large nodes for Herbalism have been added

Party windows now let you select different loot modes for your party


⚖️ BALANCING ⚖️ 
Frosty has had another balance rework


🛠️ BUG FIXES 🛠️ 
Personal loot now works in a party

Updated font on player stat bars

Game now opens in full screen the first time on a new install

Needs Ammo message now shows in chat when you don't have the required Ammo equipped

notes.title: Kando Realm Patch 2.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
ːsteamhappyː NEW CONTENT ALERT! ːsteamhappyː  

Bank Expansion for members 

Pet revival added to Dry Rum Reef  



BALANCING  

Various Dry Rum Reef's Labyrinth monsters have been relocated 

Updated Player Experience rates  



QUALITY OF LIFE  

Updated Various quest tooltips 

Loot bags now disappear if no loot is left 

Teleports now have a fade effect when used 

Recipe learning NPC Dialogue now has a unique icon Quest Acceptance and Completion UI 

improved Character Selection Screen UI updated 

Updated Membership UI + added button to shortcut bar 

Members now have coloured names 

Various Marketplace UI updates  



BUG FIXES  

Poison Bugs are now stackable 

Player Trade Window is now draggable 

Party Quest NPCs can now be interacted with
